title: At least 139 die off Djibouti as boat attempting to reach Yemen sinks, UN says
subhead: A vessel carrying 305 people from Djibouti to Yemen capsized overnight on October 8-9, a UN agency said. More than 80 people survived the shipwreck, all Ethiopian.

title: Delphine Horvilleur, rabbi: 'After October 7, it took me time to speak about the suffering of innocent Palestinians'

title: How Jeffrey Epstein used Woody Allen to expand his network
subhead: The millions of documents released by the US Department of Justice reveal that Jeffrey Epstein invested significant amounts of money and energy in building his friendship with filmmaker Woody Allen. title: ICE agents are chasing Miami's Haitians: 'No one goes out anymore, the streets and churches are deserted'
subhead: Since the end, on July 27, of a protective status that had allowed Haitians to reside in the United States, 350,000 of them have faced the threat of deportation by federal immigration authorities. Many no longer dare to leave their homes.
